_comment: md-zero-2026-08-11 PLAN.md Phase 7: check-adr-decision-implementation.py used to glob docs/adr/ADR-*.md
and parse ```decision-check fenced blocks out of the prose -- a real script reading .md content as data,
the exact class of coupling the rest of this plan removed elsewhere, just never named in the plan's own
37-coupling audit. Inverted the same way as every other Group F assertion: the claim moves here, the ADR
stays narrative-only. Each entry's `why` is REQUIRED and non-empty (check-adr-decision-implementation.py's
own R4-equivalent), same discipline check-doc-inventory.py's exempt entries and the security-pattern-sweep
allowlist already use for every recorded claim in this repo.

decisions.why: D1 accepted `context::Concept` qualified-name syntax, reusing the pack-qualification machinery unmodified. This proves the resolver actually qualifies cross-context references that way, not just that the ADR says it should.

D2 accepted that a context is a file/folder boundary composed via the existing $ref/fragment machinery (loadPackJson), not a bespoke second loader. This proves that reuse is real, not a second, divergent implementation.
D3 accepted that an undeclared cross-context reference is a named, thrown compile error, never a silent resolve-to-nothing. This proves the named error actually exists in the resolver.

D4 accepted no physical table prefixing in v1 -- the original motivating case for this whole checker: ADR-0011 D4 was ratified and ModelCompiler did not do it, undetected until a codemod ran against real content (S3 addendum). tableNameSource is the fix; this keeps it from silently regressing.
